raw_response:
Answer: C
Reason: The initial chest X-ray (Figure 1) shows severe, diffuse bilateral alveolar opacities consistent with acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS), which rapidly resolve to near-normal lung fields by day 4 (Figure 4a) following mechanical ventilation and supportive care. This rapid clearance distinguishes it from pneumonia (which resolves slower) and cardiogenic edema (typically associated with cardiomegaly and vascular redistribution not prominently featured here).
